```{r}
calcD = function(f, x, h = 10^(-8)){
  result = Im(f(complex(real = x, imaginary = h)))/h
  return(result)
}

newton = function(x, f, error = 10^(-8), ...){
  xk = x
  xk_1 = xk+1
  count = 1
  while(abs(xk_1 - xk) > error || f(xk_1) > error){
    xk_1 = xk - f(xk)/calcD(f, xk)
    xk = xk_1
    if(xk == Inf){
      return(0)
    }
  }
  return(xk_1)
}
newton = Vectorize(newton, "x")
```


```{r}
f = function(x){
  result = x + sqrt(x^2 + 1)
  return(result)
}

est_par = function(f, p){
  
  aux_f = function(x){
    return(f(x) - p)
  }
  
  my_x = newton(1, aux_f)
  result = my_x - sqrt(my_x^2 + 1)
  return(result)
}

est_par(f, 2) + est_par(f, 3) + est_par(f, 6)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

f = function(x){
  result = 2*x^2 - x - 2
  return(result)
}
f = f |> Vectorize("x")

dados = data.frame(x = seq(-10, 10, by = 0.1))
dados$y = dados$x |> f()
dados$raiz = dados$x |> newton(f = f, error = 10^(-10), h = 10^(-10)) |> round(2) |> as.factor()

ggplot(dados)+
  geom_point(aes(x = x, y = y, color = raiz))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)+
  theme_classic()

```
